name: moment
title: Moment
description: Start a focus session in Moment, pause or resume it, add time, stop it, and see how long is left.
author: milosz_falinski

commands.name: start-focus
commands.title: Start Focus
commands.subtitle: Moment
commands.description: Start a focus session in Moment, for the minutes you enter or the timer's own length.

commands.name: pause-timer
commands.title: Pause Timer
commands.subtitle: Moment
commands.description: Pause the focus session or break in progress.

commands.name: resume-timer
commands.title: Resume Timer
commands.subtitle: Moment
commands.description: Resume the paused focus session or break.

commands.name: add-time
commands.title: Add Time
commands.subtitle: Moment
commands.description: Add minutes to the focus session or break in progress: the minutes you enter, or 5.

commands.name: stop-timer
commands.title: Stop Timer
commands.subtitle: Moment
commands.description: End the focus session or break in progress.

commands.name: time-left
commands.title: Time Left
commands.subtitle: Moment
commands.description: Show how long is left in the focus session or break in progress.

tools.name: start-focus
tools.title: Start Focus
tools.description: Start a focus session in Moment. Moment never replaces a focus session or break in progress.

tools.name: pause-timer
tools.title: Pause Timer
tools.description: Pause the focus session or break in progress.

tools.name: resume-timer
tools.title: Resume Timer
tools.description: Resume the paused focus session or break.

tools.name: add-time
tools.title: Add Time
tools.description: Add minutes to the focus session or break in progress.

tools.name: stop-timer
tools.title: Stop Timer
tools.description: End the focus session or break in progress.

tools.name: time-left
tools.title: Time Left
tools.description: Read the timer: whether a focus session or break is running or paused, the time left and its length.
